$comment: Mirror of sprk_analysisaction.sprk_inputschema for compose-explain-clause (spaarkeai-compose-r2 task 040, FR-07). Normalized OpenAI-function-parameters subset (validated by CatalogInputSchemaContractTests + jps-validate). Consumes the R1 compose-selection JPS scope — the inline AI toolbar dispatches { selectionText, ... } via the shipped session-dispatch seam; selectionText is the load-bearing LLM input. Property-level "required": true is FORBIDDEN (invalid JSON Schema — use the object-level required array). Custom keywords elicitation_prompt / ledger_resolution are maker metadata (OpenAI-tolerated unknown keywords). No actionId here — it is assigned in Dataverse at deploy time (task 047). actionCode carries NO version suffix (owner hygiene).

selectionText.description: The selected contract clause (or clause fragment) to explain. The clause text the attorney highlighted in the Compose editor; interpret its legal effect in plain language. Capped upstream at the compose-selection scope's authored budget.
selectionText.elicitation_prompt: Which clause would you like me to explain? Select it in the document first.
selectionText.ledger_resolution: compose.selectionText — the current editor selection dispatched by the FR-14 inline AI toolbar (compose-selection scope)
